So the answer is Σ_j C(K,j) · (-1)^(K-j) · Σ_{a<b} P_b^j · P_a^(K-j).

import sys

def main():
    MOD = 998244353
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    N = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    A = [int(x) % MOD for x in data[2:2+N]]
    
    # Prefix sums P[0..N]
    P = [0] * (N + 1)
    for i in range(N):
        P[i+1] = (P[i] + A[i]) % MOD
    
    # Precompute powers: pw[m][i] = P[i]^m mod MOD, for m=0..K
    pw = [[1] * (N + 1) for _ in range(K + 1)]
    for m in range(1, K + 1):
        prev = pw[m-1]
        cur = pw[m]
        for i in range(N + 1):
            cur[i] = prev[i] * P[i] % MOD
    
    # Binomial coefficients C(K, j)
    C = [[0]*(K+1) for _ in range(K+1)]
    for i in range(K+1):
        C[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i+1):
            C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]) % MOD
    
    ans = 0
    for j in range(K + 1):
        m = K - j
        pw_m = pw[m]
        pw_j = pw[j]
        T = 0
        s = 0
        for b in range(1, N + 1):
            T = (T + pw_m[b-1]) % MOD
            s = (s + pw_j[b] * T) % MOD
        sign = 1 if (K - j) % 2 == 0 else MOD - 1
        coef = C[K][j] * sign % MOD
        ans = (ans + coef * s) % MOD
    
    print(ans)
